scripts.build:admin: npm run build:widgets && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin
scripts.build:member: npm run build:widgets && npm run build --workspace=apps/member
scripts._comment: Both apps resolve @apc/voting-widgets to its committed dist/, so the package must be rebuilt after any change to its source. The build:* scripts do that; the dev servers do not, so run build:widgets by hand when editing widget source.
